topic: Day 64 — reel — Resilience is how short the gap is between falling and standing up
text:
Resilience
is the [gap]
between falling
and standing.
caption:
It was never about avoiding the fall. It's how fast you get up, and that window shrinks with practice like any other skill.

Follow for one of these a day.
